requirements.speaker: user

requirements.text: +24 V supply at 2 A, analog sensor output 0-5 V at 0.1 A, ambient 60 °C
requirements.speaker: user

requirements.text: JST XH connectors on both ends; analog line must not share a route with the supply pair
requirements.speaker: user

assumptions.text: AVSS 0.5 for the supply pair and FLRY-B 0.35 for the analog line meet derating at 60 °C
assumptions.rationale: standard automotive thin-wall types; supply current 2 A is far below derated ampacity
